science: Distinguish intentional controller action authorization from actually delivered native command and post-dispatch target state under TWO unknown acknowledgments.

previous_failed_initial_attempt.issue: The previous experiment's audit compared actual native zero-arm-delta fault-delivered setpoints against authorization bounds computed for an intentionally NOT DELIVERED nonzero command; source simulations threw before full episode recording
previous_failed_initial_attempt.rule: Do not pool or describe those partial failed executions as positive or independent holdout evidence.

new_design.observed_physics: official ManiSkill CPU PhysX, native pd_ee_target_delta_pose arm-controller mode, externally frozen PPO
new_design.limit_reasoning: Commanded target NOT achieved trajectory/contact forces. Conservative multi-hypothesis SE3 candidate set under known chart. No claim of globally optimal SO(3) minimax.
new_design.important_controlled_intervention: If intentional planned authorized command is physically replaced by native zero arm command at injection steps, authorized planned-command setpoint bound is NOT asserted for that physical step. Instead audit BEFORE and AFTER private target only for physical fault validation: actual target must HOLD to within 0.0001 m/0.0001rad and hidden observer is NOT allowed to use either audit-only state. Post fault normal delivered approved actions must each meet candidate worst-case target bound.
new_design.explicit_audit_only_reads: Physical fault pre/post target checks are exclusively in auditor path, never passed to policy/belief. Privileged decision-read counts include only real command adaptation queries; oracle has unrestricted target memory and is separately denoted -1.
new_design.source_integrity: Program, certifier, protocol Git blob frozen in CI prior to full native tests. All 16 originally selected task states, complete denominator even failures.

limits: Only two frozen external task PPOs on one Panda target-controller chart
Not actual ROS packet loss, real robot hardware, VLA transfer, collision/force safety
No generic POMDP or first-ever set membership claim
This v2 study is motivated by a prior failed PILOT and is NOT blind hypothesis generation
Do not claim strict no-error certificate if any fault hold audit fails
